description: Crossfader for two sixteen-channel cables from UniRhythm: it blends the two decks into one set of gate, pitch and envelope outputs, a stereo master with an isolator and drive, and a separate cue pair

params.text: Blends the two decks, deck A alone at the left of its travel and deck B alone at the right; the shape of the blend is chosen on the menu
Switches the cue outputs between deck A and deck B, and lights while deck B is chosen
Cuts or lifts everything below 250Hz in the master mix: silence fully anticlockwise, unchanged in the middle, four times over fully clockwise
Cuts or lifts everything between 250Hz and 4000Hz in the master mix: silence fully anticlockwise, unchanged in the middle, four times over fully clockwise
Cuts or lifts everything above 4000Hz in the master mix: silence fully anticlockwise, unchanged in the middle, four times over fully clockwise
Saturates the master mix, 0% to 100%; the cue outputs are left alone by it

inputs.text: One deck, as a sixteen-channel cable: four channels per role carrying audio, gate, pitch and envelope in that order
The other deck, in the same sixteen-channel layout
Added to the crossfader, a tenth of its travel per volt; the total is held between full A and full B

outputs.text: That role's gate, taken from both decks at the gains the crossfader gives them and added
That role's pitch, taken from both decks at the gains the crossfader gives them and added
That role's velocity envelope, taken from both decks at the gains the crossfader gives them and added
The left side of the four roles' audio, panned apart, through the isolator and the drive and soft-clipped to ±5V
The right side of the four roles' audio, panned apart, through the isolator and the drive and soft-clipped to ±5V
The left side of the four roles' audio from whichever deck the cue button has chosen, panned apart and soft-clipped to ±5V, with neither the isolator nor the drive applied
The right side of the four roles' audio from whichever deck the cue button has chosen, panned apart and soft-clipped to ±5V, with neither the isolator nor the drive applied

notes: this expects the poly cable a UniRhythm puts out: channels 1 to 4 are Timeline, 5 to 8 Foundation, 9 to 12 Groove, 13 to 16 Lead.
within each group of four channels the order is audio, gate, pitch, then velocity envelope.
the four roles are panned apart by fixed amounts in both the master and the cue mix, and there is no control over that panning.
menu: Crossfader Curve — the shape of the blend: Linear, Equal Power (Recommended), which holds the loudness steady, or Cut, which keeps each deck at full until the last fifth

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
